# onCreateSchema() function

Registers a hook to run when the schema is created, ignoring a handler already registered.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function onCreateSchema(handler: CreateSchemaHook): void;
```

</tbody></table>

**Returns:**

void

## Remarks

[DependencyFor()](/api/type-graphql-dependency/latest/type-graphql-dependency.dependencyfor/) uses this internally; call it directly to defer wiring of your own that also needs the finished schema. De-duplication is by function identity, so a named function passed twice is stored once while two identical inline arrows are two hooks.
